false_authority.reason: generated pilot cannot claim normative authority

findings: Traditional PRD, requirements, journey, architecture/component and AQR views do not each require an authored authority file.
A compact system record can own goals/outcomes/journeys/requirements/questions while component records own component-scoped normative realization.
Research, durable decisions, plans and evidence should retain separate native lifecycles because their authority and mutability differ.
Existing accepted Markdown can be projected into the structured model without becoming a second editable truth.
A future migration should cut over atomically rather than leave Markdown and YAML both writable.
limitations: This is a generated pilot projection, not migration of current normative authority.
The pilot covers a small subset of AES system/Plan 001 content, not every current normative clause.
The committed Python renderer was not executed in a single local checkout in this turn.
No claim is made that YAML is universally superior to prose; the decision concerns AES canonical structured authority and generated views.
